description: Dated catalysts across US-listed companies, one row per (type, company, date): listing compliance (hearing_deadline: Nasdaq hearing request deadline; hearing_date: Hearings Panel hearing; panel_deadline; compliance_deadline; pending_suspension), reverse splits (reverse_split: the market effective date; reverse_split_meeting: a shareholder meeting with a reverse split proposal) and dilution (warrant_expiry, convertible_maturity, shelf_expiry, lockup_expiry). Filter by types, a from / to window (default today through 30 days ahead, at most 120 days) and tickers (at most 50). Each row carries title, detail, dateBasis and basisNote: "stated" = the filing, exchange list or market calendar states the date; "computed" = rule arithmetic on a stated date (for example a letter date plus 7 calendar days); "estimate" = a Signal8 estimate, not a stated date. sourceUrl links the record behind it. Per-type access follows the website: warrant_expiry, convertible_maturity and shelf_expiry need Signal8 Pro and lockup_expiry a signed-in account; a type this key may not see is status "locked" with a count and no rows, which means withheld, not absent. status "unavailable" (count null) means the source could not be read: not measured, never "none". An empty list for an "ok" type means none dated in the window on file, not that no such event exists. types.<type>.count is market-wide for the window, before the tickers filter; returned counts the rows sent; truncated true means more matched than limit. A row is a date on record, not a forecast of an outcome (a hearing can be cancelled, a split postponed, a warrant exercised early). HTTP 503 FEATURE_DISABLED means the endpoint is switched off.

from.description: Window start YYYY-MM-DD (default today, US Eastern).

to.description: Window end YYYY-MM-DD (default from + 30 days; at most 120 days after from).
